description: Look up a HyperEVM transaction by hash: sender, recipient, value in HYPE, nonce, gas limit, the 4-byte function selector and its block. Use to see what was sent or whether it exists; for success or failure and fees paid use hyperevm_receipt, for emitted events hyperevm_logs. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; an unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0xdcf371c993312e793176e32cdfa78af2101b4aa54df88f8f0051c3fe463e374a. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: hyperevm_tx
title: HyperEVM transaction
